groups.title: Engine Repair and Maintenance

Performance tuning, minor or major repairs and routine maintenance are only a few of the services we offer. All of our mechanics are factory certified and trained in Mercury, Mercury Racing, Yamaha and Volvo-Penta gas engines. Whether you need an oil change, re-flash or a re-build, our mechanics are qualified.

services.title: Routine Maintenance

Problems like a minor oil leak or fuel system contamination can lead to expensive repairs, so it’s important to have your engine inspected and serviced at an authorized dealer at least once a year, even if you haven’t reached 100 hours.

faqs.q: How much does fiberglass repair cost?
faqs.a: The cost of fiberglass and gelcoat repair can vary greatly depending on the level of damage. Our hourly labor rate is $110 per hour.

faqs.q: What causes stress cracks in fiberglass?
faqs.a: Hairline cracks, stress cracks or spider cracks can occur in the gelcoat surfaces of fiberglass boats and are often seen as a cosmetic issue. In most cases this is true, but it is important to seal them correctly, otherwise water could penetrate into the fiberglass and cause more serious damage. They occur as a result of stress and movement, manufacturing issues and environmental challenges. If structural damage is suspected, we will inspect the hull thoroughly for any moisture damage.

faqs.q: How can I avoid gelcoat stress cracks?
faqs.a: Spider cracks can be avoided by countersinking holes just through the gelcoat, so the load is placed on the structural fiberglass rather than the brittle gelcoat. Quite often, however, it’s near impossible to prevent these cracks because gelcoat is so brittle and rigid.

faqs.q: Can the shine be restored to my fiberglass?
faqs.a: The outer surface of a fiberglass boat is normally a resin called gelcoat, which protects the hull and gives it its color and shine. Time and exposure to the elements can erode the relatively soft surface of gelcoat, leaving it dull and chalky. Fortunately, the gloss usually can be restored.

faqs.q: How often should my engine be serviced?
faqs.a: Have your engine inspected and serviced at an authorized dealer at least once a year, even if you haven’t reached 100 hours, so we can attend to any tune-up, service or warranty issues.
